versions.content: Optionally, a key handler can be called if the configuration op- tion KeyMCryptoKeyHandlerStartFinalizeEnabled is set to TRUE. The KeyM_Start() function will call in turn the KeyM_KH_Start() function with the same parameter of Key M_Start(). The return value of KeyM_KH_Start() will be used as the return value of Key M_Start().
